overview_description: List, read, create, update and delete items, set their sale, purchase and inventory sections, add stock, and manage bundles, families, packages and notes.
intro: Items are the products and services you sell and buy. These endpoints create, read, update and delete items, set their sale, purchase and inventory sections, add stock to warehouses, and manage bundles, families, variations, packages and notes. This area has 41 endpoints, each available in all seven SDKs.
warning: **An item that an order references cannot be deleted.** The delete returns `409`, and retrying does not help. Deactivating or reactivating an item can return `500`, and deleting a note file currently returns `404`.
notes: **Every item JSON write is wrapped in `item`.** Two writes are not: the image upload sends `image_base64` at the top level, and the note writes are multipart forms with a `note` field.
**Address an item by its `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`.** Not by its `uuid`, and not by the integer `id` that the sale and purchase reads return.
**`type` and `name` are the minimum to create an item.** Send `type` in upper case, such as `STANDARD`, `BUNDLE`, `FAMILY` or `VARIATION_BASED`; it comes back in lower case.

**The item listing pages by cursor and filters with `filter_<field>`.** Pass `limit`, then send the `next_cursor` from `pagination` as `cursor`; `has_more` tells you when to stop. Filter with `filter_<field>`; a bare `filter` expression is refused with `400`, and `order_by` and `direction` are ignored.
**The sale, purchase and inventories reads return a short item.** Each carries `id`, `name` and its one section, and the sale and purchase reads give `id` as an integer.
**Item notes are sent as a multipart form.** The text goes in the `note` field, and files are optional extra parts.

endpoints.title: List items
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of items with their core fields and capability flags.
endpoints.description: Returns items one page at a time under `data`, with `pagination` holding `has_more` and `next_cursor`. Set the page size with `limit` and fetch the next page with `cursor`. Filter with `filter_<field>` or `filter_<field>_<operator>`: an unknown field is refused with `400`, and a value the field cannot match returns an empty `data`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: The field to sort by. Prefix it with `-` to sort descending, as in `-created_on`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item
endpoints.summary: Returns one item by its `id`, with its sale, purchase and inventory sections.
endpoints.description: Returns the item under `item`. The sale, purchase and inventories sections come inline, along with the item's bundle, family, package and variation lists.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item's information
endpoints.summary: Returns an item's core information, without its sale, purchase or inventory sections.
endpoints.description: Returns the item under `item` with its name, type, status, codes, currencies and other core fields. The sale, purchase and inventory sections are left out; read them with their own endpoints.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Create an item
endpoints.summary: Creates an item and returns it under `item`.
endpoints.description: Send the item under `item`. `type` and `name` are the minimum. A bundle lists its components in `bundle_details`, each with an `id` and a `quantity`; a variation parent sends `is_parent: true`, and a child sends `is_child: true` with the parent's `parent_item_id`.

group.description: An existing item group. An unknown group is refused with `400`.

is_parent.description: Set `true` for a variation parent. Reads back as `parent`.

is_child.description: Set `true` for a variation child. Reads back as `child`.

parent_item_id.description: The parent item's `id`, for a variation child.

sale.description: The sale section, as the sale create takes it.

purchase.description: The purchase section, as the purchase create takes it.

400.description: The `group` names no existing item group.

endpoints.title: Update an item's information
endpoints.summary: Changes an item's core information and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send only the fields that change, under `item`. Fields you leave out keep their values.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Deactivate an item
endpoints.summary: Sets an item's status to inactive and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Takes no body. After the call the item's `status` reads `inactive`; reactivate it to set it back to `active`.
endpoints.warning: **This call can return `500`.** Read the item afterwards and check that its `status` is `inactive`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

500.description: The call can fail with `500`. Read the item to check its `status`.

endpoints.title: Reactivate an item
endpoints.summary: Sets a deactivated item's status back to active and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Takes no body. After the call the item's `status` reads `active`.
endpoints.warning: **This call can return `500`.** Read the item afterwards and check that its `status` is `active`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

500.description: The call can fail with `500`. Read the item to check its `status`.

endpoints.title: Delete an item
endpoints.summary: Deletes an item. A successful call returns `204` with no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the item with that `id`; a later read returns `404`. An item that an order references cannot be deleted.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

204.description: The item is deleted. No body.

409.description: An order references the item. Retrying does not help.

endpoints.title: Upload an item's image
endpoints.summary: Sets an item's image from base64 text and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send the image as base64 text in `image_base64`, at the top level of a JSON body with no `item` wrapper. This is not a multipart upload. Afterwards the item's `image_url` holds the image's address.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item's sale settings
endpoints.summary: Returns an item's sale section in a short item with `id`, `name` and `sale`.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, sale}` under `item`. Here `id` is an integer, not the item's `id` code, so keep using the code in paths.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

200.description: The short item with its sale section, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Create an item's sale settings
endpoints.summary: Adds a sale section to an item and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send the `sale` section, and the `currencies` it sells in, inside `item`. An item takes one sale section: a second create is refused with `409` `already_exists`; change it with the update instead.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

409.description: The item already has a sale section (`already_exists`).

endpoints.title: Update an item's sale settings
endpoints.summary: Changes part of an item's sale section and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send only the sale fields that change, inside `item.sale`. Fields you leave out keep their values.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item's purchase settings
endpoints.summary: Returns an item's purchase section in a short item with `id`, `name` and `purchase`.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, purchase}` under `item`. Here `id` is an integer, not the item's `id` code.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

200.description: The short item with its purchase section, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Create an item's purchase settings
endpoints.summary: Adds a purchase section to an item and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send the `purchase` section, and the `currencies` it buys in, inside `item`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Update an item's purchase settings
endpoints.summary: Changes part of an item's purchase section and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send only the purchase fields that change, inside `item.purchase`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item's inventory settings and stock
endpoints.summary: Returns an item's inventory section and its stock per warehouse.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, inventories}` under `item`, where `id` is the item's `id` code. `inventories.warehouses` lists each warehouse with its quantities on hand, available, on order and promised.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

200.description: The short item with its inventory section, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Update an item's inventory settings
endpoints.summary: Changes an item's inventory section and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send the changes inside `item.inventories`. Turn inventory on with `enabled: true`. Warehouse management is written `warehouse_enabled`, with the `warehouses` the item is kept in and a `default_warehouse`, each by name.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Add warehouse stock
endpoints.summary: Adds stock to one or more of an item's warehouses and returns the item.
endpoints.description: List the warehouses inside `item.inventories.warehouses`, each by `name` with the `quantity` to add. A negative quantity removes stock.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

quantity.description: How much stock to add. A negative number removes stock.

endpoints.title: List an item's inventory adjustments
endpoints.summary: Returns a page of the stock changes made to one item.
endpoints.description: Returns the item's inventory adjustments under `data`, one per stock change, paged by cursor. Every quantity in an adjustment is a string, so convert it before doing arithmetic.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

200.description: A page of inventory adjustments, under `data`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item's stock in one warehouse
endpoints.summary: Returns an item's inventory section for one warehouse, named in the path.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, inventories}` under `item`, with `inventories.warehouses` holding only the warehouse named in the path. The warehouse is given by its name, not an id.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: warehouse_name
parameters.description: The warehouse's name, not an id.

200.description: The short item with the one warehouse's stock, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Update a bundle's components
endpoints.summary: Sends a bundle item's component list and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send `bundle_details` inside `item` as a plain list, each entry with a component item's `id` and its `quantity`. This differs from the family details write, which takes an object.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The bundle item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0010`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Configure an item's variations
endpoints.summary: Sets the variation options of a parent item, or the options a child item uses.
endpoints.description: A variation parent sends `configure_variations`: each entry names a variation and the `values` it offers. A child sends its `parent_item_id` and `use_variations`, naming the values it takes. Both go inside `item`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0030`. Not its `uuid`.

configure_variations.description: For a parent: the variations it offers.

use_variations.description: For a child: the values it takes.

parent_item_id.description: For a child: the parent item's `id`.

endpoints.title: List an item family's members
endpoints.summary: Returns the member items of a family item.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, family_details}` under `item`, where each `family_details` entry gives a member's `item_id` and `item_name`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The family item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0020`. Not its `uuid`.

200.description: The family item with its members, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Add or remove family members
endpoints.summary: Adds member items to a family item, or removes them, and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send `family_details` inside `item` as an object: `add` lists the item ids to add, and `remove` lists the item ids to take out.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The family item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0020`. Not its `uuid`.

add.description: Item ids to add to the family.

remove.description: Item ids to remove from the family.

endpoints.title: List an item's packages
endpoints.summary: Returns the packages defined on an item.
endpoints.description: Returns `{id, name, package_details}` under `item`. Each package has a `uuid`, which the single package endpoints take.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

200.description: The item with its packages, under `item`.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item package
endpoints.summary: Returns one of an item's packages, by the package's `uuid`.
endpoints.description: Returns the item under `item`, with `package_details` holding only the package whose `uuid` is in the path.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: package_detail_id
parameters.description: The package's `uuid`, from the item's package listing.

200.description: The item with the one package, under `item`.

404.description: The item has no package with that `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Create an item package
endpoints.summary: Adds a package to an item and returns the item.
endpoints.description: Send `package_details` inside `item` with the package's `name`, its `rank`, and a `rate_list` of member item ids and quantities. The new package appears in the item's `package_details` with a `uuid`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

endpoints.title: Delete an item package
endpoints.summary: Deletes one of an item's packages. A successful call returns `204` with no body.
endpoints.description: Deletes the package whose `uuid` is in the path; a later read of it returns `404`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: package_detail_id
parameters.description: The package's `uuid`, from the item's package listing.

204.description: The package is deleted. No body.

endpoints.summary: Returns a page of the notes on an item.
endpoints.description: Returns the item's notes under `data`, each with its `content`, `attachments` and `watchers`. The listing pages by cursor.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: How many records to return on one page.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: The `next_cursor` from the previous page, to fetch the page after it.

endpoints.title: Retrieve an item note
endpoints.summary: Returns one note on an item, under `note`.
endpoints.description: Returns the note with its `content`, `attachments` and `watchers` under `note`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`.

404.description: The item has no note with that `id`.

endpoints.title: Create an item note
endpoints.summary: Adds a note to an item, with optional files, and returns the note.
endpoints.description: Send a multipart form with the text in the `note` field. Add files as extra parts; they become the note's `attachments`.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

file.description: A file to attach. Optional; send one part per file.

endpoints.title: Update an item note
endpoints.summary: Changes a note's text, optionally adding files, and returns the note.
endpoints.description: Send a multipart form with the new text in the `note` field, as the create does. Files sent with the update are added to the note's files alongside the ones it already has.

parameters.name: item_id
parameters.description: The item's `id`, such as `ITEM-0001`. Not its `uuid`.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`.

file.description: A file to attach. Optional; send one part per file.

example.note: Reorder when fewer than ten remain.

example_call.note: Reorder when fewer than ten remain.

endpoints.summary: Deletes a note from an item. A successful call returns `204` with no body.

parameters.name: note_id
parameters.description: The note's `id`.
